description: Compare y = x and y = a*x+b, with a = 2 and b = 1. Named values are editable source; slider controls arrive later.
learningGoals: Edit an expression and compare slope and intercept.
title: Two slopes

description: Compare x^2 with (x-1)^2-1. Translation moves the vertex without changing the shape.
learningGoals: Change the horizontal and vertical offsets.
title: Moving a parabola

description: x^3-3*x has two turning points and three roots. Select the curve, then use Analyze to inspect numerical candidates.
learningGoals: Locate extrema and compare their function values.
title: Cubic turning points

description: (x-1)^2*(x+2) touches the axis at a repeated root and crosses at a simple root. A numerical scan is not a proof of multiplicity.
learningGoals: Compare touching and crossing near the zeros.
title: A root that touches

description: 1/x is undefined at zero. Two restricted domains show its branches separately, excluding the interval [-0.125,0.125] from this bounded example.
learningGoals: Zoom around zero and inspect the restricted domains.
title: Across an asymptote

description: exp(x) and ln(x) are inverse functions on their valid domains. The dashed diagonal helps compare their reflection.
learningGoals: Probe positive x values and compare the two curves.
title: Exponential and logarithm

description: Two periodic waves differ by a quarter-cycle phase shift. Angles are in radians.
learningGoals: Find crossings and compare peaks.
title: Sine and cosine

description: exp(-0.2*x)*sin(3*x) oscillates inside a shrinking exponential envelope for x ≥ 0.
learningGoals: Compare the wave with its upper and lower envelopes.
title: Damped oscillation

description: sin(4*x)+sin(4.5*x) produces a slowly varying amplitude from two nearby frequencies. The envelope is a static comparison.
learningGoals: Edit a frequency to change the beat spacing.
title: Beating waves

description: sin(x) and its explicitly authored derivative cos(x). The second expression is a normal editable curve, not a live linked analysis result.
learningGoals: Compare slope signs with the derivative curve.
title: A wave and its derivative

description: The line 2*x-1 is tangent to x^2 at (1,1). This is a fixed authored line; changing the parabola does not automatically regenerate it.
learningGoals: Probe x = 1 and request a fresh tangent in Analyze.
title: A tangent at x = 1

description: cos(t),sin(t) and 2*cos(t),sin(t), for a complete turn. Equal scale preserves the distinction between a circle and an ellipse.
learningGoals: Edit the x amplitude and inspect the parameter at a probe.
title: Circle and ellipse

description: sin(3*t),sin(2*t) traces a closed pattern from two harmonic motions. Self-crossings are part of the curve.
learningGoals: Change a frequency to explore another pattern.
title: Lissajous loops

description: t-sin(t),1-cos(t) describes two cycloid arches. Cusps are singular points, so sampling is an approximation.
learningGoals: Probe near an arch and compare parameter and x.
title: A rolling circle's trace

description: r = sin(3*theta) uses signed radius and radians. Negative radii are retained in the source rather than clipped away.
learningGoals: Try another integer in the angular expression.
title: A three-petal rose

description: r = theta/4 winds through three turns. Radius grows linearly with angle.
learningGoals: Change the radial growth rate and inspect a parameter probe.
title: An Archimedean spiral

description: r = 1+cos(theta) makes a heart-like polar curve with a cusp at the origin. Equal scale preserves its geometry.
learningGoals: Replace the constant 1 to explore a limaçon.
title: A cardioid

description: Residuals x^2+y^2-1 and x^2-y^2-1 define a circle and hyperbola. Contours are bounded numerical approximations, not topology proofs.
learningGoals: Compare closed and open contours.
title: Implicit conics

description: x^2+y^2-1 < 0 includes the disk interior but excludes its dashed boundary. Cell fills approximate the mathematical region.
learningGoals: Change < to ≤ in the editor and compare boundary styling.
title: Inside, excluding the boundary

description: Two constant pieces jump at zero, with an open left endpoint. A small measured series has a missing row at zero: neither line bridges that gap.
learningGoals: Inspect open endpoints and edit a piece without fabricating missing values.
title: Endpoints and missing data

description: A full-size deterministic measured series with cubic trend and small patterned noise. The plot is sampled for display; regression uses all 10,000 original checked rows. Select the series, choose a model in Inspector, and fit it.
learningGoals: Compare linear, quadratic, cubic and quartic fits at the point-table limit, then cancel and repeat a fit.
title: 10,000-point regression
